summary: Fixed the red V52 (standalone workspace). The standalone copy has no hub layout (no workspace-planner bridge, no packages/aicore/schemas), and three P3-era workspace tests assumed it: test_doctor and test_cli expected every doctor check to be ok (plans-migrator warns without the bridge), test_migrate read a hub aicore schema file. The two doctor tests now allow the plans-migrator warn when the bridge is absent (still all ok in the hub), and the schema test skips when the file is absent. No change to sync code in this round. V52 now prints `standalone workspace: pass`.
